plan.title: Recreate Closed RFQ with 30-Minute End Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's summary page.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the stage settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order pop-up opened.
Verify that the requested 30-minute end-time duration is offered.
Create the recreated event with the selected duration.
Verify that the recreated event retains the prepared RFQ quantity.
Verify that the recreated event retains the prepared RFQ unit.
Verify that the new live event displays its bidding end-time field.
Ensure the recreated event page has no rendering or server errors.
